Subject: Ledger apportionment discrepancy on June invoice

Hi Rohan,

We've been reviewing our June invoice and noticed an odd apportionment of a contractual credit that Redwood applied across two project ledgers. The attached invoice_pdf_202705.pdf shows a single credit of $12,450 that was split 70/30 between Project NR-LOG-01 and NR-LOG-02. That split looks unintended — our mutual action plan specified the credit should apply fully to NR-LOG-01 (the production account). Because it was split, the VAT calculation on NR-LOG-02 is now non-zero and neither ledger ties back to our internal GL.

I attached the usage-export-2027-05.csv we pulled from your usage endpoint (redacted customer ids) so you can see the session IDs and token buckets. Can you confirm:
- Why the credit was apportioned instead of applied to the single account?
- Whether we can get a corrected invoice showing the full credit against NR-LOG-01 and the adjusted VAT totals?
- If a pro-rated reversal/credit will be issued for NR-LOG-02, and how long that will take to appear on our statement?

We need an updated invoice by the week of July 5 to close our books. Please loop in billing if needed.

Thanks,

Hi Liam — thanks for flagging this and for the exports, that helped a lot. I pulled the allocation logs and ran a quick reconciliation:

Summary of what I found
- On 2027-05-31 at 22:06 UTC our allocation service deployed a default apportionment rule change that affects credits issued at the organization level. The change alters the fallback when no explicit project_id is supplied and will split org-level credits across active projects based on recent usage ratios.
- The credit in question (credit_id: CR-202705-998) was created as an org-level adjustment but did not include a project_id, so the new fallback caused the 70/30 split between NR-LOG-01 / NR-LOG-02.
- VAT was applied to the NR-LOG-02 line because the split left a residual taxable amount on that ledger.

Proposed remediation
- Issue a corrective invoice that re-applies CR-202705-998 entirely to NR-LOG-01, reversing the NR-LOG-02 VAT line and producing a credit memo for NR-LOG-02 for the gross amount plus VAT.
- Estimated provisional credit to NR-LOG-02: $3,735 (gross) / $3,150 net (example numbers; final amounts after tax reversal will appear on the credit memo).
- Expected timeline: we can produce and email the corrected invoice + credit memo within 5 business days after we receive the PO and VAT registration to put on the reissued docs.

Files I attached: signed-mpa.pdf (our copy of the mutual action plan, for reference).

Next steps for you (Liam):
- Confirm the PO number to print on the corrected invoice and the VAT reg. No changes to payment terms are required if you accept the credit memo.
- Confirm preferred billing contact (I see finance_ops@northrock.co listed).

Dylan — can you confirm whether we should treat this as a one-time adjustment (no contract change) or if legal wants us to change apportionment defaults for the account to avoid recurrence? I can hold the fix until we have direction.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
